info.title: Branch Appointments API
info.description: The branch, service catalog, capacity, calendar, staff access, customers, availability, appointments and notifications. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details. Updates of existing resources need the resource's ETag in If-Match. Admin endpoints need a sign-in with a second factor.

tags.name: Branch (admin)
tags.description: The branch's details come from configuration; the branch manager sets its weekly hours.

tags.name: Service categories (admin)
tags.description: Categories of the service catalog, each for personal or business customers.

tags.name: Service offerings (admin)
tags.description: Services the branch offers, with duration, slot interval and booking window.

tags.name: Staff (admin)
tags.description: The branch manager manages staff and their roles. Sign-in itself is Keycloak's job.

tags.name: Customers (admin)
tags.description: Branch staff search, view, create and correct customers; the branch manager changes status and erases. Every call is audited.

tags.name: Notifications (admin)
tags.description: Messages sent to customers about their appointments: types, statuses and delivery attempts.

tags.name: Calendar (admin)
tags.description: Calendar exceptions and capacity overrides of the branch. Neither checks existing appointments.

tags.name: Schedule (admin)
tags.description: Impact preview of closures, hours and capacity changes, and overbooked days to resolve.

tags.name: Appointments (admin)
tags.description: Day lists, booking for customers, and the appointment lifecycle.

tags.name: Capacity pools (admin)
tags.description: Named groups of staff at the branch whose capacity is shared by offerings.
